records.context: The settings-window backdrop has its own choice and remains active when module animation is off unless its own choice is None.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.apply_ambient_preferences#2
records.source: The settings-window backdrop has its own choice and remains active when module animation is off unless its own choice is None.
records.translation: O fundo da janela de definições tem a sua própria seleção e permanece ativo quando a animação dos módulos está desligada, salvo se a sua própria seleção for None.

records.context: Turning module animation back *on* only resumes the widgets that are actually on application view. Every module application view keeps its ambient widget alive while the user is on some other tab, and un-pausing those would spend frames on pixels nobody can see — which is the one thing this animation is not allowed to do. Their own ``showEvent`` restarts them when the tab comes back.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.apply_ambient_preferences#3
records.source: Turning module animation back *on* only resumes the widgets that are actually on screen. Every module screen keeps its ambient widget alive while the user is on some other tab, and un-pausing those would spend frames on pixels nobody can see — which is the one thing this animation is not allowed to do. Their own ``showEvent`` restarts them when the tab comes back.
records.translation: Ao voltar a *ligar* a animação dos módulos, apenas os widgets efetivamente visíveis no ecrã retomam a atividade. Cada ecrã de módulo mantém o seu widget de fundo vivo enquanto o utilizador está noutro separador; retomá-los gastaria fotogramas em píxeis que ninguém vê — precisamente o que esta animação não pode fazer. O seu próprio ``showEvent`` reinicia-os quando o separador volta.

records.context: Bounded to four lines: the strip used to take whatever height the longest help needed, so moving the pointer between two controls whose help differs in length made the whole dialog jump. The full text is still in the register and accessible description when it runs long.

records.source: Bounded to four lines: the strip used to take whatever height the longest help needed, so moving the pointer between two controls whose help differs in length made the whole dialog jump. The full text is still in the register and accessible description when it runs long.
records.translation: Limitada a quatro linhas: a faixa tomava a altura necessária para a ajuda mais longa, pelo que mover o ponteiro entre dois controlos com ajudas de comprimentos diferentes fazia saltar todo o diálogo. Quando o texto é longo, o texto completo continua no registo e na descrição acessível.
records.retired_reason: Superseded by the current scrollable help strip and its retained full text. Original source-bound evidence retained in place.
